title: AnyHarness store descriptor (harness/store.json)
description: Machine-readable schema for the ~/.agents/harness/store.json descriptor defined by spec/store-layout.md §8. The spec text is authoritative if it conflicts with this schema.

$schema.description: Canonical schema identifier for this document.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of store creation.

ExtensionKind.description: Closed enumeration of extension/component kinds defined by spec/store-layout.md §2.

name.description: The manifest's name field (Agent Plugins 1.0 §5.5 constraints).

version.description: The manifest's version field as resolved at install time.

ManifestRef.description: Pointer to a manifest document plus the version resolved at install time (spec/store-layout.md §2).
